about: ModelPilot's execution policy (switch_policy.py). Jev predicts the model and effort a task needs; ModelPilot switches there directly only when the expected total cost says it pays. Models, efforts, cache behaviour and the cost model live here so they can change without code. Prices come from the rate files merged by bench.rates().

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.why_not_candidate: Claude Code sends system-role messages mid-history after the first turn, which Haiku rejects, so a session can't be kept on Haiku (policy_actions.transform_request). Jev's probability for Haiku still counts toward the stronger models being enough.

claude-sonnet-5-5.effort_switch_evidence: Sonnet 5.5 effort changes read the tools and system (7,871-7,873 tokens) and rewrote only the messages (465-504), 8/8 (runs/thinking-probe-sonnet-5-5-20260928-133426); Sonnet 5 had rewritten everything.

claude-opus-5-5.effort_switch_evidence: Opus 5.5 effort changes kept tools and system cached and rewrote only the messages (runs/thinking-probe-opus-5-5-effort-20260926-132158).

recovery.redo_on: Jev's recommendation when at least as strong as the failed setting, else the strongest candidate setting

hysteresis_scaling: A move must beat staying by hysteresis_usd x P(the current setting is enough): full protection for a plausible current setting, almost none for one that is nearly certain to fail.

step.about: Mid-task decision points (user request, September 29). A step is due when the host-run test suite flips between failing and passing (run_tests results in the ledger), or when the task's measured spend since the last decision reaches overrun_factor x that decision's forecast for the setting it kept or chose. It needs at least min_requests_between billable requests of the task since the last decision, and there are at most max_per_revision per task revision. Candidates are a turn start's plus Jev's effort on the current model, so an effort-only move is always weighed.

return_reuse.about: Price a move to a setting whose own cache entry is still warm (sent within cache_ttl_seconds) as writing only what that entry doesn't cover. M0 measured returns to a warm model or effort without thinking history (runs/m0-replication-opus-5-5-20260924-214653, returns to Opus 5.5 18/18); with thinking history it is untested. Off until the effort-return probe, so a return is priced like a first switch.

guesses: effort_output_factor, defaults, recovery.wasted_fraction, hysteresis_usd, downgrade_switch_multiplier and the step spacing, cap and overrun factor are starting values, not measurements; tuning runs calibrate them.
